name: Katchimera Premium Stylized Mascot CGI Plus
summary: A premium stylized 3D mascot look with cartoony proportions, dynamic pose and expression, believable premium shading, and polished mobile-game charm without photorealism or battle-game aggression.
positiveStyleTokens: Fortnite-inspired silhouette clarity without combat energy
Royal Match-inspired facial readability and charm
cartoony proportions with believable premium shading
realistic lighting response on stylized materials

compositionDefaults.framing: single creature portrait with breathing room
compositionDefaults.pose: clear dynamic mascot pose with appealing movement and readable silhouette
compositionDefaults.faceRead: eyes and glow core must remain readable at thumbnail size

renderDefaults.finish: polished stylized game-mascot CGI with simplified premium forms and believable premium shading

renderRecipe.shapeRule: stylize anatomy and pose aggressively, simplify body masses, overscale the hero motif
renderRecipe.surfaceRule: keep shading believable and premium, but keep textures simplified and graphic
renderRecipe.lightingRule: use real studio-light logic with key, fill, rim, bounce, and contact shadow
renderRecipe.detailRule: spend the richest shading on eyes, glow core, and the hero motif; keep the rest broader and cleaner

comparativeNotes.fortnite: borrow silhouette confidence, strong pose design, and stylized render polish, but avoid hero aggression and combat energy
comparativeNotes.royalMatch: borrow facial charm, cartoony readability, color clarity, and instant appeal, but avoid cheap toy-commercial plastic and over-bright casual-game polish
comparativeNotes.realisticCG: borrow lighting logic and premium shading response, not realistic anatomy or heavy texture realism
comparativeNotes.princessDoll: landmark rares can feel regal, but they should stay creature-first rather than doll-first
